## Learning Objectives

- Differentiate between standard experimental designs and extended structures like generalized block designs and Latin squares.
- Recognize when and why generalized block designs are needed to account for systematic differences.
- Understand how Latin square designs control for two blocking factors and when they are appropriate.
- Apply appropriate statistical models to analyze data from these expanded design structures.
:::
